_readme: Topics for Elite FBA's blog. Jack chose a mix (12 Nov 2026): mostly Amazon UK selling guides, some mentorship posts. Each service lists hand-written keywords per angle (a search a real person types), so the angle templates are only fallbacks. 'summary' is what the writer treats as true (only facts also in site.config.ts 'about', plus general Amazon know-how with no fee figures). 'category' groups the blog index (app/lib/blog-config.ts). One post per keyword, about 55 in all: at 3 a week that runs to about March 2027. Add keywords before then; npm run seo:generate -- --stats shows what is left.

services.name: Starting Amazon FBA
services.keyword: how to start amazon fba uk
services.summary: Amazon FBA (Fulfilment by Amazon) means the seller buys the stock and sends it to Amazon's warehouses; Amazon stores it, picks, packs and delivers orders, and handles customer service and returns, and the seller keeps what is left after costs. Elite FBA's Module 1 starts from zero: how FBA works, how the money works, wholesale and bundling, and the lean model of validating small before scaling. Module 2 walks through opening a seller account screen by screen.

keywords.a1: how to start amazon fba uk
keywords.a3: is amazon fba worth it uk

services.name: Amazon seller account
services.keyword: how to open an amazon seller account uk
services.summary: Opening an Amazon UK seller account: Individual or Professional plans (the trade-off between a per-item fee and a monthly subscription, and that the Buy Box needs a Professional account), the signup wizard, identity verification including the video call, and day-one account hygiene to avoid suspension. Elite FBA's Module 2 covers this screen by screen. Fees change, so readers check the current plan fees on Amazon's own pages.

keywords.a1: how to open an amazon seller account uk
keywords.a2: amazon individual vs professional seller account
keywords.a4: amazon seller account suspended during verification

services.name: Product research
services.summary: Finding and validating products to sell on Amazon UK: what makes a viable product or bundle, sourcing from physical shops, online directories and wholesale suppliers, a step-by-step validation of demand, competition and price on Amazon before buying, and testing a small batch first. Elite FBA's Module 3 covers this, including a bundle opportunity test and approaching wholesale suppliers.

keywords.a2: how to find products to sell on amazon uk
keywords.a3: how to validate a product on amazon
keywords.a4: what to sell on amazon fba uk
keywords.a5: how much stock to buy for amazon fba first order

services.name: Bundling on Amazon
services.keyword: how to create a bundle on amazon uk
services.summary: Bundling means combining products into a multi-pack or set that is listed as its own product on Amazon. Elite FBA teaches bundling as a core model: finding bundle opportunities, sourcing the parts, listing the bundle under a generic brand with a GTIN exemption, and preparing it so each unit is compliant. Amazon has rules on what makes a valid bundle, so readers check Amazon's current bundling policy.

keywords.a1: how to create a bundle on amazon uk

services.name: Wholesale sourcing
services.summary: Wholesale on Amazon means buying stock from wholesalers or distributors to resell. It covers finding UK wholesale suppliers, contacting and negotiating with them, opening trade accounts, checking whether a brand or category is gated, and why invoices from authorised suppliers matter. Elite FBA gives members its own supplier email and negotiation scripts.

keywords.a2: how to find wholesale suppliers for amazon uk
keywords.a3: how to email a wholesale supplier

services.name: Amazon listings
services.keyword: how to create an amazon listing
services.summary: Creating an Amazon listing that gets found and converts: the parts of a listing and the job each does, writing the title, bullet points and description (AI can give a first draft to edit), images, and going live. Elite FBA's Module 4 covers this, and members get Jakub's listing audits.

keywords.a1: how to create an amazon listing
keywords.a2: how to write amazon product title
keywords.a3: how to write amazon bullet points
keywords.a5: amazon listing suppressed how to fix

services.name: GTIN exemption
services.summary: A GTIN exemption lets a seller list a product without a barcode (EAN or UPC), for example a generic-brand bundle. Elite FBA's Module 4 covers listing under a generic brand with a GTIN exemption. Amazon decides each request by category and brand, so readers check Amazon's current exemption rules in Seller Central Help.

keywords.a2: how to list on amazon without a barcode

services.name: Sending stock to Amazon
services.keyword: how to send stock to amazon fba uk
services.summary: Getting stock into Amazon's warehouses: preparing and polybagging units, the labels and suffocation warnings each unit needs, packing outer boxes and the heavy package rules, creating the shipment in Seller Central and tracking it until it is live. Elite FBA's Module 5 covers this end to end. Prep rules change, so readers check Amazon's current FBA packaging and prep requirements.

keywords.a1: how to send stock to amazon fba uk

services.name: Amazon FBA costs
services.summary: The costs of selling with FBA in the UK, explained by type and never by figure: the seller plan subscription, referral fees, FBA fulfilment fees, storage fees, optional costs like advertising, plus VAT. How to work out whether a product leaves enough after all costs before buying stock. Fees change, so readers check the current figures with Amazon's fee pages and revenue calculator in Seller Central.

keywords.a2: how much does it cost to start amazon fba uk
keywords.a3: how to work out profit on amazon fba

services.name: Amazon PPC
services.summary: Amazon PPC (Sponsored Products and other ads) for new sellers: campaign types, automatic and manual targeting, reading the search term report, and keeping spend under control. Elite FBA's Marketing module covers visibility, keywords and the tools that scale a brand, and members get recorded teardowns of real ad accounts.

keywords.a2: how to set up amazon sponsored products

services.name: Building an Amazon brand
services.keyword: how to build a brand on amazon uk
services.summary: Moving from reselling to owning a brand on Amazon: knowing when you are ready, registering a trademark, Amazon Brand Registry and what it protects, and expanding beyond a single listing. Elite FBA's Launching a Brand, Expansion and Long-Term Maintenance modules cover this. Readers check Amazon's current Brand Registry requirements and the UK IPO for trademarks.

keywords.a1: how to build a brand on amazon uk

services.name: Amazon FBA mentorship
services.summary: What a 1-to-1 Amazon FBA mentorship is and how to judge one: who the mentor is and whether they still sell, how often you get real time with them, what support you get between calls, and what is included. Elite FBA is a 1-to-1 mentorship with Jakub, a full-time Amazon UK seller: a weekly 1-to-1 call, direct messaging between calls, the 9-module course, his SOPs and scripts, teardowns and a private community, with limited places and no upsells.

keywords.a4: are amazon fba courses worth it
keywords.a5: how to spot an amazon fba guru scam

services.name: FBA alongside a job
services.term: amazon fba with a full time job
services.keyword: amazon fba with a full time job
services.summary: Running an Amazon FBA business alongside a 9-5: why FBA suits it (Amazon handles storage, delivery and customer service), how to plan weekly time, and building slowly with savings rather than debt. Jakub built his business on the side of a 9-5 and only left once the income was steady enough to replace his salary; he does not promise anyone the same result.

keywords.a1: amazon fba with a full time job
keywords.a2: how many hours a week does amazon fba take
